pli-tv-pvr17:101.1: attādānaṃ ādātukāmena bhante, bhikkhunā katīhaṅgehi samannāgataṃ attādānaṃ ādātabbanti?
pli-tv-pvr17:102.1: attādānaṃ ādātukāmenupāli, bhikkhunā pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ,
pli-tv-pvr17:102.4: ‘yaṃ kho ahaṃ imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātukāmo, kālo nu kho imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātuṃ udāhu no’ti.
pli-tv-pvr17:102.6: akālo imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātuṃ, no kālo’ti. na taṃ upāli, attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr17:103.1: sace panupāli, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti :
pli-tv-pvr17:103.2: kālo imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātuṃ no akāloti, tenupāli bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ :
pli-tv-pvr17:103.3: ‘yaṃ kho ahaṃ imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātukāmo, bhūtaṃ nu kho idaṃ attādānaṃ udāhu noti.
pli-tv-pvr17:103.4: sace panupāli, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti :
pli-tv-pvr17:103.5: ‘abhūtaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ, no bhūta’nti, na taṃ upāli, attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr17:104.1: sace panupāli, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti :
pli-tv-pvr17:104.2: ‘bhūtaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no abhūta’nti. tenupāli bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ :
pli-tv-pvr17:104.3: yaṃ kho ahaṃ imaṃ attādānaṃ ādātukāmo, atthasaṃhitaṃ nu kho idaṃ attādānaṃ udāhu noti.
pli-tv-pvr17:104.4: sace panupāli, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti :
pli-tv-pvr17:104.5: ‘anatthasaṃhitaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no atthasaṃhita’nti. na taṃ upāli, attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr17:105.1: sace panupāli, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti :
pli-tv-pvr17:105.2: atthasaṃhitaṃ idaṃ attādānaṃ no anatthasaṃhitanti. tenupāli, bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr17:105.3: imaṃ kho ahaṃ attādānaṃ ādiyamāno labhissāmi sandiṭṭhe sambhatte bhikkhū dhammato vinayato pakkhe udāhu noti.
pli-tv-pvr17:105.4: sace upāli, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti :

pli-tv-pvr17:106.1: sace panupāli, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti :
pli-tv-pvr17:106.2: ‘idaṃ kho ahaṃ attādānaṃ ādiyamāno labhissāmi sandiṭṭhe sambhatte bhikkhū dhammato vinayato pakkhe’ti, tenupāli, bhikkhunā uttariṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ :
pli-tv-pvr17:106.3: ‘imaṃ kho me attādānaṃ ādiyato bhavissati saṅghassa tatonidānaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ kalaho viggaho vivādo saṅghabhedo saṅgharāji saṅghavavatthānaṃ saṅghanānākaraṇaṃ udāhu noti.

pli-tv-pvr17:106.5: ‘imaṃ kho me attādānaṃ ādiyato bhavissati saṅghassa tato nidānaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ kalaho viggaho vivādo saṅghabhedo saṅgharāji saṅghavavatthānaṃ saṅghanānākaraṇanti. na taṃ upāli attādānaṃ ādātabbaṃ.
pli-tv-pvr17:107.1: sace panupāli bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti :
pli-tv-pvr17:107.2: ‘imaṃ kho me attādānaṃ ādiyato na bhavissati saṅghassa tato nidānaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ kalaho viggaho vivādo saṅghabhedo saṅgharāji saṅghavavatthānaṃ saṅghanānākaraṇa’nti, taṃ ādātabbaṃ upāli, attādānaṃ.
